title: Adding Voice Cloning to Text-to-Audio-Video Models with a Single Zero-Initialised Layer
abstract: arXiv:2608.15690v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Text-to-audio-video (T2AV) generation models produce a video and its soundtrack from a textual description, but offer no control over whose voice speaks in the output. We show that a base T2AV model can be turned into a voice-cloning model by adding a single zero-initialized linear layer on top of its audio backbone, fine-tuning for a comparatively short training schedule, and conditioning on a short reference recording at inference time. The reference is injected through two complementary signals: its diffusion latents are prepended to the audio stream, and a global speaker embedding modulates token of the target audio. translated_title: 在文本到音视频模型中通过单个零初始化层添加声音克隆功能
translated_abstract: 文本到音视频（T2AV）生成模型能够根据文本描述生成视频及其配乐，但无法控制输出中说话者的声音。我们证明，通过在基础T2AV模型的音频骨干网络上添加一个零初始化的线性层，进行相对较短的训练计划，并在推理时以短参考录音为条件，即可将基础T2AV模型转变为声音克隆模型。参考录音通过两种互补信号注入：其扩散潜在变量被前置到音频流中，同时一个全局说话人嵌入调制目标音频的令牌。在一个包含30位说话者、674对说话者-文本对的基准测试中，我们与五个强大的声音克隆文本到语音基线进行了比较：我们增强的5B模型在三个独立的验证网络（ECAPA-TDNN、WavLM-SV、Resemblyzer）中达到了最高的说话人编码器余弦相似度（SECS），且具有统计显著性。
tldr: 通过在文本到音视频模型的音频骨干上添加一个零初始化线性层并进行短时微调，即可实现高质量声音克隆，且无需修改视频生成部分。
en_tdlr: Adding a single zero-initialised linear layer to a text-to-audio-video model enables voice cloning with minimal training, achieving state-of-the-art speaker similarity.
